info.name: ruby
info.category: Interpreted — MRI bytecode VM; optional YJIT/MJIT
info.design_notes: Ruby's expressiveness and Smalltalk-like object model come with per-method-call overhead. Recent YJIT (Ruby 3.2+) speeds up hot paths considerably but the language still trails statically-typed peers on raw arithmetic. The ecosystem is biased toward web and scripting.
key_traits: Late binding everywhere; method calls go through dynamic dispatch
YJIT closes some of the gap on hot loops
info.peak_speed: ~30–100× slower than C++ without JIT; YJIT improves hot paths 1.5–3×
info.memory_baseline: High — like Python, every value is a heap object
